# What should you charge for this laser job?

> Free laser cutting and engraving price calculator: enter the piece size, cut path, engraved area, sheet material, nesting, laser time, labour and setup, and get a price per piece with quantity breaks. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/laser-cutting-engraving-job-price-calculator/)
